nutshell.headline: 2 new Survey failures are a QA MongoDB authorization outage, not a code regression.
nutshell.causeText: Both new failures are server-side HTTP 500s from the QA test-link microservice, whose MongoDB rejects commands with error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa. This is a QA environment/auth problem, not the regression suite. The rules engine flagged NXS-13622 (gergely.gimesi) only via a path match on SurveyCRUDTestSteps.groovy, but a WaitUtil/test-step change cannot cause a server-side Mongo auth failure, so no commit or developer is implicated.
nutshell.investigation: Both new Survey failures return HTTP 500 from the QA test-link service because MongoDB rejects commands with error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa — a QA infra issue. The NXS-13622 correlation is a path-match false positive.
bullets: 2× Survey (SurveyCRUDTestSteps): test-link endpoints return HTTP 500 from QA
Root cause: MongoDB error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa (server-side)
No code blame — regression-suite changes cannot cause a QA Mongo auth failure

detail.investigation: Both of the 2 new failures (prior build had 1) are in Survey/SurveyCRUDTestSteps: 'Get list of test links' and 'Get test links from S3'. Each is a server-side HTTP 500 from the QA test-link microservice (dk-project-test-link-rest.nexus-ms-qa.dynata.com), and the response body's root cause is org.springframework.data.mongodb.UncategorizedMongoDbException: 'Command failed with error 13: Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa. That is a QA MongoDB authorization/credentials problem in the environment under test — not a Spock assertion ('Condition not satisfied') and not a socket timeout. The cluster label 'other' is generic; the real message is unambiguous infra. The rules engine flagged NXS-13622 (gergely.gimesi) purely because SurveyCRUDTestSteps.groovy appears in commit 42105d2df34b, but those changes (WaitUtil.untilTrue plus step refactors) cannot produce a server-side MongoDB auth failure, so no code change is implicated and no developer is blamed. Recommended action: QA/platform should restore the test-link service's MongoDB authorization on nexus-api-mongo-qa and re-run.
bullets: New failures (2 of 2; prior build had 1): Survey · SurveyCRUDTestSteps · 'Get list of test links' and 'Get test links from S3'.
Both fail with HTTP 500 from the QA test-link service (dk-project-test-link-rest.nexus-ms-qa.dynata.com).
Root cause in body: MongoDB error 13 'Authorization failure' on nexus-api-mongo-qa (UncategorizedMongoDbException).
Signature is infra/environment (server-side 5xx + Mongo auth), not an assertion or a timeout.
Cluster 'other' is only a coarse label; the real message identifies the cause clearly.
NXS-13622 path-match (SurveyCRUDTestSteps.groovy) is a false positive — test-step/WaitUtil changes can't cause a server-side Mongo auth failure.
No developer or commit is implicated.
Action: QA/platform to fix MongoDB authorization on nexus-api-mongo-qa, then re-run.
